nuclearScienceRule: Nuclear support (uranium processing, waste vault, waste refinery) unlocks beside the reactor, above every non-nuclear building (max 25,000) and below the 1,000,000 reactor, so it is bought in the run-up rather than as a mid-game dead end.

restaurant.requirementStatus: Build 41 native cooking, cake/coffee meals and conditional water verified; wider acceptance tracked in tools/STATUS.md
restaurant.mealFoodStatus: First proposed menu; user requires fish, berries and other real foods
restaurant.flow: Reserve seat, sit, worker serves meal and one water if the diner can use its native thirst effect, deduct actual goods atomically, apply each served good's native consumption effects; a full meal (one of each main food) also applies Fine dining (RestaurantDining) once, while out-of-stock main foods are left off a partial meal without it; leave.
requirements: No food or bonus before service
No service without an attending worker
No duplicate meals after save/reload
No single-use restaurant ration

hospital.requirementStatus: Builds 63/66 passed native treatment, 30-patient capacity, staff, supplies, power, access, save/reload and neighborhood care; economic balance pending
hospital.balanceStatus: Initial playtest values; costs, staffing, supplies and neighborhood radius require economy review
hospital.patientStay: Admitted until cured: every treatment effect has SatisfyToMaxValue, so native AttractionNeedBehavior returns to the stay until all four conditions are at their maximum. The ward stays open while a crew is assigned (on call day and night) and treats at crew strength; it closes, releasing patients, only without power, crew or patient meals.

patientMeals.policy: Admitted patients cannot leave to eat, so the Hospital stocks every faction food (carried Box goods with a Hunger effect, chosen at runtime) and water, delivered by native haulers, and feeds patients the stocked good native InventoryNeedBehavior would choose. Water covers waterDays for every bed at the zombie rate (zombieNeedMultiplier x native Thirst).

hospital.supplyPolicy: Fixed supplies per staffed, powered operating hour cover the ward and preventive neighborhood care; native fractional supply buffers persist through saves. Staff use none of the thirty patient places.
hospital.rateInterpretation: 80 percent faster recovery means 1.8 times the native Medical Bed healing rate, or 5/9 of its treatment time. It does not mean 80 percent shorter treatment time.

nativeTreatmentEvidence.status: Build 63 measured Medical Bed 0.009583455/hour and Hospital 0.01672733/hour in a short 1.03125-hour sample: ratio 1.745439, within 0.08 of the 1.8 steady target. Build 66 passed exact reload, neighborhood gain/decay, medicine exhaustion/replenishment and three-staff injury recovery at 0.009666424/hour.

hospital.areaRadiusStatus: Ten-cell native rectangular radius; two wellbeing points, shared need across hospitals. Build 66 verified actual inside gain and outside decay, with medicine gating. Economic balance pending.
requirements: Use native condition recovery
Separate effects for the three conditions
Shared capacity of 30 patients
No immunity to continued badwater exposure

groceryStore.requirementStatus: Native services and access passed builds 68/69; physical belt intake, limits, power and saved-queue continuity passed 73/75; economic balance pending
groceryStore.balanceStatus: Initial authored balance; economic playtesting pending
groceryStore.stockStatus: Six existing edible goods, 100 each; PackagedFood is the existing general preserved food
groceryStore.flow: Stock existing foods, provide ordinary native consumer access to their food effects, provide a stocked neighborhood wellbeing effect.
groceryStore.servicePolicy: Native shoppers may collect food even off duty or without power. Two clerks haul stock. The neighborhood bonus needs at least one attending clerk, power and three stocked food types; it consumes no service tokens. Public inputs receive food, while takeable goods are reserved for native shoppers rather than exported to factories.

One store offers several food types
Stocking/radius values require balancing

powerPlants.status: Designed 2026-10-22: generated by create_frontier_expansion_content.mjs (makePowerPlant) from their late-game studies (tools/lategame_batches.json); workerless since 2026-10-27 (the native Steam Engine generator replaced the staffed Smelter workshop and its CoalFiring/OilFiring recipes); not built or tested in game.
powerPlants.generator: Native Iron Teeth Steam Engine pattern (generator GoodPoweredGenerator), no workers: GoodConsumingBuilding consumes fuelPerHour of fuel and waterPerHour of Water (inventory for fullInventoryWorkHours hours), GoodPoweredGenerator gives full output while it consumes and none without supplies or while paused, with the Steam Engine's PowerGeneratorSounds, PowerGeneratorParticleController smoke, GoodPoweredGeneratorAnimator and MechanicalNodeIlluminator. Native GoodPoweredGenerator pauses consumption while the power graph does not require power, so fuel burns only while the network draws power, day and night.
powerPlants.sizing: Demand measured from the generated Iron Teeth blueprints (MechanicalNodeSpec.PowerInput) on 2026-10-22; scenarios and plant counts in docs/progression.md (Power plants).

oilAndProtection.status: User requested; recipes, assets and gameplay integration pending
oilAndProtection.legacyPolymer: Replace the generic Polymer draft with PolymerResin and Plastic at the producing source. Do not silently rename goods in saves or alias old IDs.
oilAndProtection.equipment: Reusable suits with no durability or routine maintenance loop. Exact ingredients and equipping/return rules require implementation.
oilAndProtection.radiationTransport: Shielded pipe pieces for explicitly radioactive liquid goods; solid waste uses appropriate inventories/conveyors. Do not assume ordinary Badwater is radioactive.
oilAndProtection.radiationStorage: Purpose-built shielded warehouses/tanks block stored-material radiation when intact. Persistent waste remains non-deletable and blocks demolition until emptied.
oilAndProtection.protectionBoundary: Equipment and shielding reduce exposure; neither replaces reactor cooling or emergency shutdown.
